assays.assay_description: Rats were placed individually in a small upside-down glass aquarium (17 × 10.5 × 9 cm) on a wire mesh frame inside a sound-attenuating box with high-speed cameras. Behaviour was video-recorded for 45 min and head-twitch responses were detected using DeepLabCut pose-estimation and SimBA machine-learning classification. Tested under DOI alone (0.3125-2.5 mg/kg) and under DOI (1.25 mg/kg) with pretreatment by ketanserin, SB 699,551, or ASP 5736.

outcomes.summary: DOI dose-dependently increased head-twitch responses in male rats, with significant effects at 1.25 and 2.5 mg/kg (ED50 = 1.163 mg/kg). The 5-HT2A antagonist ketanserin (0.625 mg/kg) attenuated DOI (1.25 mg/kg)-induced HTR, whereas the 5-HT5A antagonists SB 699,551 (3, 10 mg/kg) and ASP 5736 (0.01, 0.03 mg/kg) did not. Digital (DeepLabCut+SimBA) counts correlated very highly with human observer counts (r² = 0.9985).
outcomes.statistics: Exp 1: KW(5)=17.04, p<0.01; 1.25 mg/kg vs vehicle p<0.05; 2.5 mg/kg vs vehicle p<0.001; ED50=1.163 mg/kg (CI 0.8370-1.560), Hill slope=2.187. Exp 2: KW(7)=25.97, p<0.001; DOI 1.25 mg/kg vs vehicle p=0.0204; ketanserin+DOI vs DOI p=0.0282. Human vs machine: r²=0.9985 (CI 0.9518-1.045), p<0.0001.
outcomes.evidence: Following DOI administration, the animals displayed a dose-related increase in the head-twitch response ... ketanserin attenuated DOI-induced head-twitch response (p = 0.0282), the 5-HT5A receptor antagonists SB 699,551 and ASP 5736 did not affect DOI's action

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single HTR assay; consolidated as one entry.
DOI was the only psychedelic; ketanserin, SB 699,551, and ASP 5736 included as additional administered compounds in dosing (antagonists co-administered with the psychedelic).
Vehicle set to 'water' per explicit statement that all compounds were dissolved in sterile water (overriding gptoss's 'saline').
DOI: doses_mg_per_kg formatted as numeric list (qwen used trailing zeros, harmonized).

D1 set to 'Single session' (score 0): each treatment condition was a one-shot 45-min recording. Although animals were tested across multiple days under different drug conditions (within-subjects crossover), these are different assay-condition sessions, not repeated recordings of the same condition.
D3 set to 2-7 because individual rats were tested across multiple days (no more than 2/week) under different conditions, contributing recording data on multiple days for this assay.
B1 scored 0 (single measure: HTR count) per rubric (1 measure = 0 points); glm's score of 1 was an error.
DOI doses 0.3125/0.625 should not be confused with ketanserin 0.625; doses_mg_per_kg listed separately per compound.
Age scored young_adult based on 225-250 g + ~3 weeks acclimatization in adult-sized Wistar rats.
